Emergency water treatment

If you have no other way to treat water, add 8 drops (1/8 teaspoon) of unscented household bleach per gallon of clear water. Stir and let it stand for 30 minutes. The water should have a slight chlorine odor.

Cloudy water

If the water is cloudy, let it settle and filter it through a clean cloth first, then use 16 drops per gallon.
